home.title: Master Data
home.description: Customer, supplier, and item records will be added here.

customer.title: Customers
customer.name: Name
customer.invalidCode: Use 1–30 letters, digits, hyphens or underscores.
customer.invalidName: Enter a name of up to 200 characters.

customerImport.title: Import customers
customerImport.hint: Download a template, select an xlsx or CSV file (up to 2 MB and 1,000 rows), then preview. Existing codes are skipped. Correct every error before committing.

customerContact.title: Contacts and addresses of {{code}}
customerContact.hint: Each record saves on its own. Sales documents use the default contact and address; setting a new default clears the old one.
customerContact.name: Name
customerContact.invalidName: Enter a name of up to 100 characters.
customerContact.invalidAddress: Enter an address of up to 300 characters.
customerContact.defaultNeedsActive: An inactive record can't be the default. Clear the default or keep it active.

supplierContact.title: Contacts of {{code}}
supplierContact.hint: Each record saves on its own. Purchase documents use the default contact; setting a new default clears the old one.

supplierImport.title: Import suppliers
supplierImport.hint: Download a template, select an xlsx or CSV file (up to 2 MB and 1,000 rows), then preview. Each row can include one default contact. Existing codes are skipped. Correct every error before committing.

itemImport.title: Import items
itemImport.hint: Download a template, select an xlsx or CSV file (up to 2 MB and 1,000 rows), then preview. Item code, name and base unit code are required. Existing codes are skipped. Correct every error before committing. Opening stock is not imported.

itemAttributeValue.title: Attributes of {{code}}
itemAttributeValue.invalidAttribute: Choose an active attribute, each only once.

warehouse.title: Warehouses & locations
warehouse.name: Name
warehouse.invalidCode: Use 1–30 letters, digits, hyphens or underscores.
warehouse.invalidName: Enter a name of up to 200 characters.

storageLocation.title: Locations in {{code}}
storageLocation.hint: Locations have one level; put zone, aisle and shelf in the code, such as A-01-03.
storageLocation.name: Name
storageLocation.inactiveWarehouse: The warehouse is inactive. You can't add locations, but you can still edit or delete existing ones.
storageLocation.invalidCode: Use 1–30 letters, digits, hyphens or underscores.
storageLocation.invalidName: Enter a name of up to 200 characters.

currency.title: Currencies & exchange rates
currency.hint: Each company has one base currency. Exchange rates are quoted as 1 foreign currency = rate × base currency.
currency.name: Name
currency.baseHint: To change the base currency, mark another currency as base. It cannot change once exchange rates exist.
currency.invalidCode: Enter a three-letter ISO 4217 code, such as USD.
currency.invalidName: Enter a name of up to 200 characters.
currency.invalidDecimals: Enter a whole number from 0 to 4.

exchangeRate.title: Exchange rates of {{code}}
exchangeRate.hint: 1 {{code}} = rate × base currency. Periods include both dates and cannot overlap.
exchangeRate.inactiveCurrency: The currency is inactive, so no rates can be added. Existing rates can still be edited or deleted.
exchangeRate.invalidPeriod: The end date cannot be earlier than the start date.
exchangeRate.invalidRate: Enter a rate above 0 with up to 6 integer and 8 decimal digits.

taxCode.title: Tax codes & rates
taxCode.hint: Tax rates are percentages with effective periods. Documents look up the rate covering their business date and keep it.
taxCode.name: Name
taxCode.invalidName: Enter a name of up to 200 characters.

taxRate.title: Tax rates of {{code}}
taxRate.hint: Rates are percentages from 0 to 100. Periods include both dates and cannot overlap.
taxRate.inactiveTaxCode: The tax code is inactive, so no rates can be added. Existing rates can still be edited or deleted.
taxRate.invalidPeriod: The end date cannot be earlier than the start date.
taxRate.invalidPercent: Enter a percentage from 0 to 100 with up to 4 decimals.

taxCalc.title: Calculate tax with {{code}}
taxCalc.hint: Uses the rate covering the date and rounds by the currency's amount decimals. Gross = net + tax.
taxCalc.invalidCurrency: Enter a three-letter currency code, such as TWD.
taxCalc.invalidAmount: Enter an amount with up to 11 integer and 4 decimal digits.

account.title: Chart of accounts
account.hint: Subaccount codes start with the parent code and keep its type. Only active accounts without subaccounts can be posted to. Code, parent and type cannot change after creation.
account.name: Name
account.invalidPrefix: The code must start with {{code}} and be longer.
account.invalidName: Enter a name of up to 200 characters.
